speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
text: The Society of Saint Maur is more commonly known as the Infant Jesus Sisters, or IJ Sisters, in Singapore.

speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
text: The order arose in response to the dire need in those days to provide young girls, especially those from disadvantaged families, with a good education.

speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
text: Over 169 years of history in Singapore, scores of girls have had their lives transformed through the work of the IJ Sisters.

speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
text: As a former IJ girl, it is my privilege to move this Bill.

speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
text: The IJ Sisters approached me to represent them.

speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
text: And we have worked closely to ensure that the Ordinance will be current and relevant to their needs.

speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
text: The properties in Malaysia listed under the First and Third Schedules are not under the Society of Saint Maur in Singapore, and the property in Singapore listed under the Second Schedule is no longer owned by the corporation.

speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
text: The corporation continues to own other properties in Singapore and the Bill also includes the necessary saving provision to ensure that existing property rights and any other rights and obligations will not be affected by the name change.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: As the Bill is a Private Bill, in accordance with the provisions of Standing Order 87(3), the Bill will be referred to a Select Committee.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: The Clerk will now proceed to read the Orders of the Day.
